description: Header file defining the EffectsFactory API for Android audio effects, including functions for querying, creating, releasing, and describing effects.

methods.name: EffectQueryNumberEffects
methods.description: Returns the total number of effects available in all loaded libraries.

methods.name: EffectQueryEffect
methods.description: Retrieves the descriptor of the effect at a given index.

methods.name: EffectCreate
methods.description: Creates an effect instance with a specified UUID and session ID.

methods.name: EffectCreateOnDevice
methods.description: Creates an effect attached to a specific audio device.

methods.name: EffectGetDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the descriptor for a given effect UUID.

methods.name: EffectIsNullUuid
methods.description: Checks if an effect UUID is null.

methods.name: EffectDumpEffects
methods.description: Dumps information about all effects to a file descriptor.
